name: YottaCode
notes: New catalog identity. Current official docs publish a checksum-verified Linux/macOS installer for a single Go binary, installed as yottacode, with local Ollama and OpenAI-compatible providers, persistent memory, approvals, worktree-parallel sessions, typed subagents, skills, MCP, GitHub workflows, and a recent v0.4.0 public-launch release.

name: proto
notes: New catalog identity. Official upstream documents a one-shot installer, npm package fallback, local/privacy-first operation, support for OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, and Gemini endpoints, browser automation, persistent task tracking, skills, and a terminal-first TUI.

name: MiniMax Code
notes: New catalog identity. Current official documentation publishes the macOS/Linux/WSL installer and mcode binary, with BYOK support for OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible providers, session resume, headless exec, subagents, plugins, MCP, and ACP.

name: dcode-ai
notes: New catalog identity. Current upstream documents a Rust-native single binary with TUI, resumable sessions, headless NDJSON/JSON automation, subagents, optional git worktrees, runtime IPC, multi-provider switching, agent profiles, permissions, and skill discovery.

name: kore
notes: New catalog identity. Current upstream documents a single Rust binary that wraps Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, OpenCode, and Antigravity so agents can message, watch, spawn, fork, and coordinate across terminals without a background service.

name: Junie CLI
notes: New catalog identity. Current JetBrains docs publish stable, EAP, nightly, and experimental terminal installers for the junie binary, with LLM-agnostic BYOK support, JetBrains account auth, local models, terminal/CI/GitHub workflows, and automatic channel updates.
